in.definition: Inside a place or enclosed area.

on.definition: Touching and supported by the surface of something.

under.definition: Below something else, often covered or sheltered by it.

behind.definition: In or to or toward the rear.

in-front-of.definition: In a position that is ahead of or facing the front side of something.
in-front-of.exampleUsage: The bicycle is in front of the building.

next-to.definition: Immediately beside or very close to something or someone.
next-to.exampleUsage: The library is next to the park.

between.definition: In the space separating two people or things.

above.definition: An earlier section of a written text.

inside.definition: Relating to or being on the side closer to the center or within a defined space.

outside.definition: Relating to or being on or near the outer side or limit.

beside.definition: Shows that one thing is next to or very near another thing.

near.definition: At a short distance from someone or something.

far.definition: At a great distance from a person or place.

opposite.definition: On the other side, facing someone or something.

against.definition: Touching a surface while resting or leaning against it.

around.definition: On every side of something, or moving in a circle.

among.definition: Shows that something is shared or happens within a group of people or things.

within.definition: Inside a place, area, or stated limit.

beyond.definition: Farther along in space or time or degree.

into.definition: Showing movement from outside to inside a place or thing.

out-of.definition: Moving from within a container, boundary, or enclosed area to a location beyond it.

onto.definition: Being aware of someone or something, or trying to discover more about it.

through.definition: Moving into one side of something and out the other.

across.definition: From one side of an area to the other.

along.definition: Following the length or direction of something.

over.definition: Beyond the top or upper surface or edge.

past.definition: A earlier period in someone's life (especially one that they have reason to keep secret).

toward.definition: Moving in the direction of a place or goal.

bottom.definition: Situated at the bottom or lowest position.

left.definition: Being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north.

right.definition: Being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the east when facing north.

center.definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region.

middle.definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region.

corner.definition: A place off to the side of an area.

edge.definition: The outside limit of an object or area or surface.

side.definition: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location.

end.definition: The surface at either extremity of a three-dimensional object.
